name: TMGMT LanguageLine
description: TMGMT translator plugin for Capita LanguageLine Solutions human translation service.
project_description:
Overview 
 LanguageLine Solutions plugin, SmartMATE Drupal Connect, provides a professional website translation service for the Translation Management Tool module (TMGMT).

 With SmartMATE Drupal Connect, TMGMT editors can submit their Drupal content directly to Capita TI’s translation management system, SmartMATE. Set-up is quick & secure, and content can be sent for translation in the click of a button. Translation projects can be tracked and are received back within the Drupal dashboard, simplifying the translation process. SmartMATE Drupal Connect also allows you to benefit from Capita TI’s cost-saving language technology tools. 

 Features 
 
 Send content for translation at any time of day, from anywhere in the world 
 Automatic project assignment 
 Access to technology tools, including custom built translation engines, translation memories, quality checks and terminology management 
 Access to 250+ languages 
 Dedicated Project/Account Manager to handle any queries 
 Secure, encrypted systems ensure your content stays confidential at all times 
 
 Next Steps 
 
 Fill out this form to let us know about your Drupal project and translation needs. 
 Install TMGMT module and Capita Translation and interpreting provider. 
 Follow the Configuration Instructions . 
 Obtain sandbox and production authorisation tokens from Capita Translation and interpreting. 
 Manually or automatically select content you want translated (with 60+ available languages). 
 Receive high quality translated content right back into Drupal. 
 Review, approve and publish your translated content. 
 Please be aware that the Capita Translation and interpreting Provider currently supports Drupal 8. If your system is Drupal 7.x, and you are interested in a backport of our plugin to meet your localization needs, please let us know . 
 
 About Capita Translation and interpreting 
 Capita Translation and Interpreting (Capita TI) is a leading global language services supplier, with a strong focus on innovation and technology. Our mission is to combine innovative people, process and technology, to enable our customers to communicate with anyone, anywhere.

 What makes us different from other language service providers? Our capacity to integrate the best people in the industry with cutting-edge technology, to deliver an innovative and customised language ecosystem.

 We are ISO accredited for our information security (27001), quality of language services (9001:2015), quality of translation services (17100:2015) and environmental management (14001).
